hypothesis: The prior correct candidate used 256 threads processing 2048 inputs per CTA and added a scratch-backed stage when it produced more than 1024 partials; it measured 10.216 µs over three samples versus the baseline's 47.079 µs. This candidate doubles first-pass work to 4096 inputs per CTA while keeping 256 threads. At n=4,194,304 that yields 1024 partials, which one final 256-thread CTA can sum, testing whether avoiding the extra stage and launch outweighs increased per-CTA work and a single-CTA final pass.
